name: shenwa-hybrid-research
description: Hybrid investment research mode: Shenwa supplies the analysis body while a data-source skill supplies the fact base and cross-check layer, under a 50/50 split with customer preference externalized.

displayDescription.en: Runs single-task investment research on a 50/50 split: Shenwa supplies the analysis body while a data source supplies the fact base and cross-check layer, delivered as a validation table.
displayDescription.zh: 以「深挖出分析主体、数据源做事实校验」的 50/50 分工完成单项投研任务，按客户偏好裁剪输出，每个数字都附逐项校验表。
